funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage; must have a confirmed publisher and a publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any career stage; higher tiers (£8,001‑£20,000) require postdoctoral level experience.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals enrolled in or about to start a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to help students begin or continue postgraduate study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country.
opportunities.summary: Supports research trips to examine eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a one‑year master’s degree (or two‑year part‑time) in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals with an offer for a UK doctoral degree starting between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding for doctoral research, covering tuition and living costs over three years.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) and above.
opportunities.summary: Supports an in‑depth research project that aims to reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship (British School at Rome)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree; from pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium for research on British‑Italian topics.
